text:
samantha: Quick async sync — handing off Console Observability work for the next sprint. Need signoffs/owners for dashboards, trace hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestone. TL;DR: who's owning what?

andrew: I can take dashboards (metrics pages + per-route latency). Status: wireframes done, started prometheus queries.

julia: I’ll own trace hooks and the sampling config. PR for the tracer middleware is up (WIP). ping me for reviews.

samantha: @julia thanks — can you confirm the KV cache tags we need in spans? Ops wants to avoid perf regressions.

julia: yep — adding span.attr: {"cache.hit", "cache.prefix"}. will post example in PR.

ben: I can pick up error-analysis views (grouping by model + prompt_id). Need clarification on retention policy — do we keep enriched traces for 30d or 90d?

samantha: product asked for 30d for now, with opt-in 90d for enterprise. We should gate 90d behind the retention feature flag and storage pricing note.

mike: FYI dedicated infra team depends on the retention config to size S3 buckets. Need finalized numbers by EOD Friday. @andrew can you surface expected metrics cardinality?

andrew: rough estimate: 2000 unique routes, p95 tokens ~120, metrics cardinality ~50k labels. I'll push a spreadsheet tonight.

samantha: Ownership recap: dashboards -> andrew, trace hooks -> julia, error views -> ben, retention config -> samantha + eng-infra (mike). Is everyone OK with that?

julia: OK from my side. I'll add a dev task to instrument trace sampling and a small e2e test.

ben: one ask — error-analysis needs links from traces to console logs (job id). Is there an auth dependency? security team asked for scoped tokens.

mike: security note — need short-lived presigned URLs for cross-service enrichments. eng-security already has a draft. I'll loop them in.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Prod tracer-middleware branch failed CI on integration tests (timeout). See: https://ci.internal/1234

julia: saw the CI failure, repro locally, working on a fix for a race in KV cache init. will update PR later today.

samantha: blockers: CI flaky on trace middleware, infra sizing numbers pending from andrew, and retention policy doc finalization. Small wins: dashboard wireframes done.

andrew: action items: upload cardinality spreadsheet + sample queries by tonight.

julia: action: push fix + request reviews.

ben: action: mockup error grouping UI and list required logs fields.

mike: action: set up meeting with eng-security and infra on Thursday 10am.

samantha: I'll create a short checklist in the repo (OWNERs + milestones) and link here once done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

andrew: ack :eyes:

julia: thx everyone

samantha: tagging this thread for async progress — please update when complete so I can mark milestone in roadmap.
